blurb: Dance Theatre Of Huntsville offers dance classes for children and adults in styles including ballet, hip hop, jazz, tap, modern, African, and more. Programs range from introductory classes for ages 2 1/2 to 6 years, to advanced ballet and a pre-professional dance company for ages 7 to 21. They also offer summer dance camps, master classes, and an annual dance production.
